_about: Canonical strings for waterdamagegwinnett.com (RULES.md 0.4, WDG-REGISTRY). This file owns the exact approved text; RULES.md owns the policy and conditions. Pages, templates and monitors read these values, and any mismatch fails validation (from PR 3). Change a string here and in the pages in the same PR. Lives under .github/ so it is never deployed or served.

PHONE_COUNTY.owner: Gwinnett County Water Resources 24/7 emergency line

FEE_DISCLOSURE_EN.text: We may be paid a fee for each call by the participating providers or call networks we route calls to. Calls are routed based on location and availability, not a ranking of quality.

FEE_DISCLOSURE_ES.text: Es posible que los proveedores o redes de llamadas participantes a los que dirigimos las llamadas nos paguen una tarifa por cada llamada. Las llamadas se dirigen según la ubicación y la disponibilidad, no según una clasificación de calidad.

HOME_SERVICES_DISCLAIMER_EN.text: Water Damage Gwinnett is a free service to assist homeowners in connecting with local service providers. All contractors/providers are independent and Water Damage Gwinnett does not warrant or guarantee any work performed. It is the responsibility of the homeowner to verify that the hired contractor furnishes the necessary license and insurance required for the work being performed. All persons depicted in a photo or video are actors or models and not contractors listed on Water Damage Gwinnett.
HOME_SERVICES_DISCLAIMER_EN.rule: WDG-DISCLOSURE (RULES.md 9.4); re-check against Marketcall's Creative Submission Rules when the offer activates

HOME_SERVICES_DISCLAIMER_ES.text: Water Damage Gwinnett es un servicio gratuito para ayudar a los propietarios de vivienda a conectarse con proveedores de servicios locales. Todos los contratistas/proveedores son independientes y Water Damage Gwinnett no garantiza ni avala ningún trabajo realizado. Es responsabilidad del propietario verificar que el contratista contratado cuente con la licencia y el seguro necesarios para el trabajo a realizar. Todas las personas que aparecen en una foto o video son actores o modelos y no contratistas listados en Water Damage Gwinnett.
